key_difference: (D) adds its own UTF-8 decoding path (a new QUrlLocalFileUtf8Traits plus a fromUtf8 call) instead of rejecting every decoded byte >= 0x80 the way (B) does, and it omits (B)'s Windows precheck that rejects literal (already-decoded) backslashes in the input, so on Windows a path containing '\\' with no '%' still decodes successfully.
